headers.description: HTTP header names are case-insensitive; either spelling of Authorization is accepted.

^[Aa]uthorization$.description: Operator-issued customer key. Absent means anonymous Free.

include.description: Comma-separated. inputs, coaching and evidence need Pro; the server answers 403 before inference otherwise.

lang.description: auto, or BCP 47 tags separated by commas: en, en,te, te-Telu-IN. The server reads each tag by its language subtag, so te-Telu-IN reads as te.

expected_text.description: Optional copied reference passage for passage-verified recognition.

profile.description: Optional school, class and child profile as JSON text: definitions/layers of backend/languages/profile.schema.json, at most 16384 bytes in UTF-8. Sent with each request and never stored; the response carries only its hash as ruleset. A refused profile is HTTP 413 or 422 before the photo is read.

age_band.description: Optional writer's age as two whole-year ages from 3 to 18, the first below the second, such as 6-7. Never a birth date. Echoed in the report as age_band and not stored; no score uses it yet (#216). A refused band is HTTP 422 before the photo is read.

size_bytes.description: 5 MiB per upload; the whole request body must stay under 6 MiB.

pdf_pages.description: Only the first page is analysed.

image.description: Metadata of the uploaded file, not its bytes. width x height must not exceed 24,000,000 pixels; check that product in code, JSON Schema cannot multiply.

title: POST /api/v2/reports request
description: Model of one multipart request as an object, for clients that validate what they are about to send and for contract tests. The wire format is multipart/form-data; let the HTTP library set the boundary. Never put the credential in the query string.
